_comment: SDET Application Bug Discovery Utility — checked-in defaults.
Precedence: code defaults < this file < CRAWLER_* env vars < values passed to crawlApplication().
startUrl is omitted on purpose so BASE_URL from .env.local / .env.e2e drives the target;
set CRAWLER_START_URL for a one-off run against a different screen.
SAFETY: allowWrites and allowDestructive are both false. Turning them on lets the crawler
submit forms and press Delete against a live environment — do that only on a disposable one.
